vegetation_edition_note: LANDFIRE 2020 retains circa-2016 EVT labels except specified urban, disturbance, agriculture and developed-ruderal updates. It is not a 2026 survey.
terrain_note: The 2020-labelled terrain products were prepared in late 2021 and published in 2022. Source terrain metadata records zero-filled nodata in some coastal-buffer areas; zero elevation/slope is not independently verified as flat terrain.
coverage_note: Reported coverage measures valid source pixels inside the LANDFIRE unbuffered CONUS geographic extent, not field validation or environmental accuracy. The source boundary replaces a simplified model-domain outline that excluded some coastal locations.
